acceptable_hypotheses: Traffic volume may contribute but does not explain the measured pool waiters.
Redis contention is not supported by direct evidence.
corrective_actions: Alert on acquisition waiters and connection saturation.
expected_findings: Payment 5xx responses followed increased worker concurrency.
Database connection utilization rose with API latency.

expected_timeline.event: Database connections near the configured maximum

resolution_details: Worker concurrency was rolled back and connection utilization and API latency were observed until they declined.
root_cause: Payment worker concurrency was raised beyond the safe database pool capacity, exhausting PostgreSQL connections.
